gwas_notes: Used PLINK --linear without mixed model correction. λ≈2.96 indicates severe genomic inflation from uncontrolled population structure. 715 'significant' SNPs are mostly false positives. Manhattan + QQ plots produced. λ reported but incorrectly attributed to polygenicity rather than stratification.
regulatory_method: Heuristic Regulatory Potential Score (RPS) based on statistical features (MAF, SNP density, spacing, signal strength, CpG proxy)
regulatory_notes: No sequence extraction, no ML model, no pig-mutbert. Hand-crafted scoring formula using GWAS statistics and genomic context features. Produces numerical RPS values (0-1) but method is not sequence-based regulatory activity prediction.
